title: Revenue Receipts Non Tax Revenue Receipts
definition: Non-tax revenue receipts comprise government earnings from sources other than taxes, such as interest on loans, dividends from public sector undertakings, profits of the Reserve Bank of India, fees, fines, and external grants, which do not create liability or reduce assets.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding government fiscal architecture, fiscal deficit management, and alternative resource mobilization strategies for sustainable public finance in UPSC Prelims and Mains GS Paper III.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Revenue Receipts Non Tax Revenue Receipts.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Government Budgeting
Constitutional provisions regarding Consolidated Fund of India (Article 266)
